name: Kendo-Seedance 2.5+Qwen
readme:
# Kendo-Seedance 2.5+Qwen

Studio v3.1.0-studio.3: video and still images through one server-side KIE API key.

- **Page HTML:** port 3000. Video: /seedance25.html. Still images: /images.html.
- **Comfy MCP:** port 3001. One access-code URL includes ComfyUI and KIE image/video tools. The code is generated at first boot and retained on the volume.
- **ComfyUI:** port 8188. **JupyterLab:** port 8888.

Set KIE_API_KEY in the Pod environment before launch. Video supports Seedance 2.5 or regular 2.0. Still images have a right-side selector: Seedream 5.0 Pro, FLUX.2 Pro, Qwen Image 3.0 Pro, Grok Imagine Image 2.0, Nano Banana Pro and GPT Image 2. All use the same key and MCP URL.

Image resolution defaults to 2K where supported. Nano Banana Pro and GPT Image 2 also offer 4K; Grok uses provider-selected resolution. Start with 3 reference slots and add one at a time; limits, file size, aspect ratio, format and approximate price adjust to the selected model. Confirm before submitting a paid job. Results/history are stored on /workspace/kendo-kie.

Local Qwen GPU generation and automatic model downloads remain disabled. ComfyUI and existing model files are retained. Container disk and persistent volume default to 100 GB each; a Network Volume has its own size.

See https://github.com/mamypoko2008/kendo-comfyui-h3/blob/main/STUDIO.md for release details. No paid provider generation was run during release tests.
